title: Create: Stratus Terra SMP
description: Official SMP Server for the Create: Stratus Terra Modpack
body:
This is the Official SMP Server for the Create: Stratus Terra Modpack.

We have spent countless Hours tweaking the World Generation and modifying the Modpack to try and give you an enjoyable Experience.

Get ready to experience a beautiful world, play the Create mod in all of its glory, team up with friends to raid vanilla friendly dungeons, explore the world, build your factories, process goods and trade with other players!
